name: correctness-cross-file-caller
title: Correctness — a changed return contract an untouched caller still reads the old way

pullRequest.title: Return the discount amount alongside the total
pullRequest.body:
The price panel has to show "you saved $4.50", and today the only way to get that number is to re-run the code lookup in the view layer, which has already drifted once.

So `applyDiscount` now returns `{ total, applied }` instead of a bare total. `buildQuote` is updated to destructure it and carries `savedCents` through to the panel.

No behaviour change: the total is computed exactly as before, and the minimum-subtotal rule is untouched.
pullRequest.author: tom-okafor
